description: Google Tag Manager administration. Changes land in a workspace; nothing reaches the live site until publish_version. Actions: create_tag(workspace_path, name, type, parameters?, firing_trigger_ids?, blocking_trigger_ids?), update_tag(tag_path, name?, parameters?, firing_trigger_ids?, blocking_trigger_ids?), pause_tag(tag_path, paused?), create_trigger(workspace_path, name, type, filters?, custom_event_filters?, auto_event_filters?), create_variable(workspace_path, name, type, parameters?), create_version(workspace_path, name?, notes?). Destructive (confirm:true): delete_tag(tag_path), publish_version(version_path). parameters use the GTM API Parameter shape, e.g. [{"type":"template","key":"html","value":"<script>...</script>"}].

params.description: Action parameters; destructive actions also need confirm: true

name: gtm_admin
